summary: Completed comprehensive testing of OG page cards feature and mobile responsiveness audit. Backend OG card endpoints working perfectly. Mobile responsiveness excellent across all pages. Desktop navbar functionality confirmed. Minor frontend issue: OG meta tags not updating correctly in document head.

ui_bugs.issue: OG meta tags (og:image) not updating correctly on /briefings, /books, /lounge pages. Pages pass correct image prop (e.g., ${SITE_URL}/api/og/page/briefings.png) but document head shows fallback Unsplash image instead
